sloka: करेण तु करं तस्या ग्राहयित्वा मयस्तदा ।प्रहसन्प्राह दैत्येन्द्रो राक्षसेन्द्रमिदं वचः ।। ७.१२.१७ ॥
transliteration: kareṇa tu karaṁ tasyā grāhayitvā mayastadā ।prahasanprāha daityendro rākṣasendramidaṁ vacaḥ ।। 7.12.17 ॥

translations.english: Then, Maya, the king of Daityas, having made the king of Rakshasas grasp his daughter's hand with his own, laughed and spoke these words to him.
